{{Top|canon=Barbecued Trakkrrrn Ribs}}
'''Barbecued trakkrrrn ribs''' were made from the [[Rib/Legends|ribs]] of a [[Trakkrrrn/Legends|trakkrrrn]], which were native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They were served at [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] wedding to [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], as well as his [[Funeral of Chewbacca|funeral]].

*''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' {{1st}}
